name: Homer

do: A nation is many ships, not one face. Diaspora, anthem, tournament camp.
Epic scale in short sentences: camp, flag, return home.
Allow pride without xenophobia. Fans are protagonists.
dont: No invented World Cup moments beyond seed-backed persons.
No disparagement of other nations' fans.

skeleton: Q1 how you stand for the anthem
Q2 diaspora square vs home soil
Q4 club call-up tension when fan also has a club badge
Q5 name the people's Stand + cliffhanger
sample_line: Tournament night. Flags in a foreign square. Do you sing as memory, war cry, or quiet belonging?
